started:
Started {handle}. Link: {url}
Next: call add_slides now with only the title slide and one or two short spoken sentences.
playable:
Playable after {seconds} s: {url}
Send this link to the user now, in a message, before your next tool call. Then keep adding one to three whole slides per add_slides call. The authoring guide follows.
pending:
Slides saved. The opening audio is still being made, but the link already works: {url}
Share it with the user now; playback starts when the audio is ready. Then keep adding slides.
voice_error:
Slides saved, but voicing failed: {error}
Link: {url}. Continue with the next add_slides call. If the error repeats, stop and ask the user to run `showntell doctor`.
need_opening: Nothing to play yet: no narration so far. Send the title slide with at least one spoken sentence, a plain paragraph rather than a > line.
finished:
Finished: {slides} slides, {duration}. {url}
Tell the user the walkthrough is finished and give them the link. Do not repeat the script.
loading: The voice model is not ready yet: {status}. Your slides are saved and will be voiced once it is. Keep adding slides; a later reply will say when the link is playable.
